BiblicalUsage: The word names refuse, the offscouring swept away, and Jeremiah uses it once, in the lament over Jerusalem: God has made us as the offscouring and refuse in the midst of the people. The holy city has become the sweepings of the nations.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that the refuse in Lamentations is the lowest place a people can fall, and yet the prophet keeps praying, because even the offscouring is not beyond God's mercy.
